categories_review.source: README Supported features: connects ESPHome Device Builder, compiles ESPHome firmware, verifies and publishes OTA binaries, and manages device firmware updates through a HA sidebar. Primary computers_network covers the actual computing/firmware tooling use across ESPHome devices; no specific end-device product class or cloud developer service is claimed.

descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that connects to the ESPHome Device Builder add-on, builds your ESPHome firmware there and serves it to your devices over HTTP OTA. The add-on needs no extra configuration.
descriptions.ko: ESPHome Device Builder 애드온에 연결해 펌웨어를 빌드하고, Home Assistant가 HTTP OTA로 기기에 제공하는 커스텀 통합입니다. 애드온에는 별도 설정이 필요 없습니다.
